The comment says "When we are talking about the rendering" — this could be considered somewhat identifying, but not a specific section. The most defensible score is 3.

Rationale A: Says the comment doesn't explicitly reference a specific section/table/figure, authors can make an educated guess but cannot confidently pinpoint.
